RFC 4301 Section 4.4.1: "Every SPD SHOULD have a nominal, final entry that matches anything that is otherwise unmatched, and discards it." Tested: "a nominal, final entry that matches anything that is otherwise unmatched, and discards it". Gap: "Every SPD". Producer: internal/component/ike/dataplane/vpp_policy.go::vppPolicyInterface. applyConfig now pins spdForwardAnswer across operator SPD reconciliation while keeping assertUnmatched first on first apply, releaseSPD pins s.spdForward on operator removal and still removes the catch-all last after warnSPDLeft, and installUnmatched (installUnmatchedEntries) supports ForwardDefaultInstaller with reload undo while failing closed on any reload refusal. TestRFC4301FinalEntryIsUnderEveryZeSPDEntry replays startup apply, Child SA PROTECT entries and shutdown, asserting exact write counts (protectWrites and others), SPActionDiscard on all six catch-all entries at every write holding another Ze entry, and zero entries after release. All other tagged units (default final entry, inbound clear discard, interface SPD builder/apply/refusal/release/kernel discard) still enforce the Tested scope. Gap stands: VPP SPDs (vppPolicyInterface / CatchAllSupported returning ErrNoNodeWideSPD) and OSPFv3 RFC 4552 manual-key entries (defaultDataplaneSource, buildIPsecPolicies) carry no final DISCARD entry. Scoped evidence only; zero whole-requirement credit.
